description.en: Periodic sweep: open TODOs in saas-factory project, dependency updates, container cleanup. Requires a SaaS factory in the project (directory saas-factory/ or FACTORY_ROOT with the CLI tools/factory); it is not part of this repository.
description.de: Regelmäßiger Sweep: offene SaaS-Factory-TODOs, Dependency-Updates, Container-Cleanup. Voraussetzung: eine SaaS-Factory im Projekt (Verzeichnis saas-factory/ oder FACTORY_ROOT mit der CLI tools/factory); sie gehört nicht zu diesem Repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Runs on a schedule (weekly). Cleans up old containers, lists open TODOs, triggers Auto-Fix for test-failed TODOs if they are not fixed yet.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
FACTORY="${FACTORY_ROOT:-./saas-factory}"
echo '=== Cleanup of old containers/images (>14 days) ==='
"$FACTORY/tools/factory" cleanup --older-than 14 || true

You have the output of block 1 (cleanup) and block 2 (open TODOs).

## SaaS Factory weekly report ({{ run_timestamp }})

- Containers/images cleaned up: <count, if available>
- Open TODOs: <number>
- Top priorities: <up to 3 HIGH/CRITICAL TODOs>
